messages:
mike: Heads-up — after the console rollout this morning some tenants are seeing mixed routing: console shows v2 active but requests land on v1.
ops-bot: deploy v2-console-toggle to prod completed at 2024-04-10T09:12Z :rocket:
sara: Confirmed. I pulled a session for tenant 'acme-inc' — headers include X-Client-Version: 2.0 but routing decided on v1 handler. Adding traces.
raj: I think this is the header coalescing issue we saw in canary. Edge LB merges duplicate headers; our route decision uses first header, console writes last. We'll need normalized header order.
mike: Can we hotfix routing to prefer X-Route-Override if present? Current precedence: X-Client-Version > X-Version-Hint. Might need to change.
oliver: Short-term patch: update router to treat X-Route-Override as canonical. I can ship a guardrail. Any telemetry we can use to verify impact?
eva: Telemetry warning — v2_route_count metric is reporting ~30% less than expected for these tenants. I suspect our telemetry aggregation uses header key X-Version-Hint which the console stopped sending.
mike: So two issues: 1) precedence mismatch (router vs console) 2) telemetry key change. We should fix precedence and add a migration shim to console to write both headers for 2 weeks.
sara: Proposed plan: (1) router patch that prefers X-Route-Override (canary 50% in us-west), (2) console patch to emit both headers, (3) dashboard annotation and alert update. I'll own 2 and 3.
raj: I'll own 1. Sending PR with fallback logic: if X-Route-Override present use it, else existing rules. Also log when header mismatch occurs (rate-limited).
mike: Sounds good. Add an eval event for telemetry: emit mismatch_count tag so devex can graph. Also add a short console helptext: 'If you override route, ensure header X-Route-Override is set.'
oliver: FYI quotas — this mismatch led to some tenants getting v1 quotas applied, which bumped latency SLOs. Need to check per-tenant quota assignment logs.
eva: I'll reconcile quotas in the billing telemetry table for impacted tenants and run a backfill for indicators.
mike: Timeline? Raj can you start the canary today? Sara patch scheduled for tomorrow morning. We'll post an announcement in #eng-platform and #incidents.
raj: Canary started 15:20 UTC, routing patch rolled to 10% first. Will report back by 16:30.
ops-bot: automated alert cleared: v2_route_mismatch_rate -> decreasing :white_check_mark:
